title: Pengorbanan Nyang Rela .
intro: Lam masa ujian ilahi, saboh jiwa geukheun keu buet nyang paleng akhe keu tundok. Dibesarkan di tanoh yang tan, tokoh nyoe timoh untuk mewujudkan iman dan kesabaran. Bak watée saboh wahyu jipeurintah keu jipeuseumah keureubeuen, awaknyan hana jiragu-ragu. Kisah awaknyan na kheueh batée landasan bakti.
clues: Lon nakeuh jaweueb keu doa sidroe nabi nyang rayeuk nyang ka treb that geupreh.
Lon ngon mak lon tinggai lam glé nyang seupôt ngon beukai kurma ngon ie mantong.
Lon rayeuk jeut keu nabi nyang terkenal deungon kebenaran dan kesabaran lon.
Lon bantu ayah lon peudong pondasi rumoh suci nyang geukhususkan keu Allah.
Watée ayah lôn peugah haba keu ulôn keuhai lumpoe ulôn keu lôn keureubeuen, ulôn jaweueb, 'Peubuet kheueh lagée nyang ka geupeurintah ubak gata.'
Allah geuhoreumat keuseurah ulôn deungon geukirém saboh bubiri agam nibak langèt keu teuboh ulôn.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Teungoh jitiek lam apui nyang teungoh meuapui-apui .
Teungoh geu uji ngon peunyaket nyang brat .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Teuboh ngon bubiri agam nyang rayeuk .
outcome.answer: Teuboh ngon bubiri agam nyang rayeuk .

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
